description: Validate a proof token online. Checks the token signature, expiry, and revocation status against the server, and optionally that the proof is about the identifier you expect. Public endpoint — no API key required.

identifier.description: Optional: the identifier this proof should be about (phone, email, domain, ...). When supplied, a proof about anything else answers valid:false with reason "identifier_mismatch"; a proof of an encrypted decision answers "identifier_unverifiable".

proof_token.description: The JWT proof token to validate

name: validate_proof

outputSchema.description: Proof validation result. Returns verification details when valid, or reason/message when invalid. A DELEGATION token answers with `token_type: "delegation"` and the `delegation` block instead of `verification`; its status resolves the cascade down to the domain control proof, which neither the status list (it packs each row's own bit) nor an offline signature check can show. Delegation-specific reasons: `unknown_delegation` (no registry record — delegations are minted fail-closed, so this is invalid, not merely unresolvable), `status_unavailable`, and `identifier_unverifiable` when an `identifier` binding is requested for a delegation.

delegation.description: Delegation claim set, present when a valid delegation token was submitted. The attestation is domain authorization of the artifact — NOT that the artifact is safe, audited or endorsed.

proof_id.description: Public proof id (ph_ctl_*), present when the proof is registered

reason.description: Failure reason: expired, revoked, suspended (a reversible pause — the owner can lift it), invalid, identifier_mismatch (the supplied identifier is not what this proof is about), or identifier_unverifiable (the proof's hash is derived from ciphertext, so no identifier can be bound to it)

revoked_at.description: When the proof was revoked (only present when reason is "revoked")

revoked_reason.description: Reason for revocation (only present when reason is "revoked")

suspended_at.description: When the suspension began — present only with reason `suspended`

token_type.description: Present ONLY when the submitted token is a delegation (m-delegation-verifier-ref). Its absence means the answer is about a verification/decision proof and the `verification` block applies.
